title: One line naming what would enter Core
kind: new-concept | new-root-export-family | new-binding-primitive | new-capability-family | runtime-dependency | core-file | budget-growth | correctness-or-security-fix
invariantOrUseCase: The universal invariant or use case; why every ordinary application needs it.
whyNotHtmlCss: Why native HTML, CSS or browser behavior cannot satisfy it.
whyNotCapabilityPack: Why an optional capability pack cannot.
whyNotHostRenderer: Why an optional host or renderer cannot.

consumerEvidence.evidence: Where it needs this, as a path or link

consumerEvidence.consumer: A second independent consumer (required for a new concept, export family, primitive or family)

complexityDelta: The change on every dimension of npm run check:core-budget -- --report.
compatibilityImpact: What breaks, what migrates, and how.
negativeBoundaryTests: The tests proving optional layers still cannot leak into Core.
guestLanguageImpact: Impact on F#, C# and Rust engines and bindings.
